id: title:Gilbert09:keep the schedule on for an automatic widen re sync

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery preservation. The change prevents permanent disabling of warehouse schemas when an automatic reset-and-resync is pending, preserving schedule recovery and avoiding wasted loads. This applies to PostHog's warehouse ingestion and warehouse connector workflows.
review.reason: Adds a conditional guard and documentation update to warehouse ingestion failure handling. P1.F1.H4 and P1.F1.H2 introduce checks before permanently disabling warehouse schemas, preserving recovery schedules. P1.F1.H3 updates documentation to clarify this behavior. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit depends on warehouse-specific failure behaviors not demonstrated in this chunk; no adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assigned.
